questions.question: A company wants to set up a highly available workload in AWS with a disaster recovery plan that will allow the company to recover in case of a regional service interruption. Which configuration will meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: For high availability plus recovery from a regional service interruption, run across two Availability Zones in one Region and use a DIFFERENT AWS Region as the disaster-recovery site. Keeping the DR site in the same Region wouldn't survive a regional outage, and running active across multiple Regions is more than this requirement asks.
